title: Enterprise compatibility onboarding lane and prioritized stability gate for customer model requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Proposal: implement a two-lane intake and triage flow for customer-submitted model requests that balances enterprise SLAs with catalog safety and quality. The flow creates an 'Enterprise Compatibility' lane with a prioritized stability gate and temporary pinning policy for contracted customers. Objectives: 1) Let enterprise customers get a fast, observable onboarding path when they request model additions or variant pins; 2) Ensure models meet runtime compatibility, latency/cost budgets, and regression thresholds before and during a pinned window; 3) Reduce manual back-and-forth by codifying a lightweight rubric and automated pre-checks (compatibility smoke tests + eval gate staging). This ticket defines the rubric, required artifacts, rollout criteria, and initial dashboard/alert requirements for the lane.
acceptance_criteria: Define a compact enterprise intake rubric (<=6 checks) covering compatibility, security, regressions, cost/latency budget, data access, and legal constraints
Design a temporary pin policy for enterprise requests: automatic temporary pin (TTL 30 days) on approval, with required shadow trial started within 48 hours and hard rollback if regression detected
Implement a published checklist and Confluence playbook that Solutions/SEs can use to submit fully-formed requests

Create a minimal automated pre-check pipeline (repo PR + smoke test job) that runs: model format checks, tokenization/embedding parity, basic latency benchmark against customer's SLO, and a light quality regression test on a customer prompt sample
Wire up a Console dashboard showing: pending enterprise intake items, pin status, shadow trial progress, and regression alerts; include cost burn projection for pinned workload
Stakeholders (PM, ENG runtime, ENG infra, Security, Solutions) have reviewed and accepted the rubric and rollout plan in the Confluence doc
steps: Draft rubric and temporary pin policy (this ticket)
Prototype a smoke test job in ENG CI that accepts a model artifact link and a small customer prompt set
Add intake form fields in Console (requester, customer contract ID, sample prompt set, max acceptable latency and per-token cost) - Design & Frontend
Establish shadow trial template: traffic percentage, duration, failure thresholds, auto-fallback rules
Build dashboard tiles and alerting rules (Console) for pinned models and shadow trials
Run a 2-week pilot with 1-2 trusted enterprise customers and collect metrics and feedback
Iterate rubric and automation based on pilot, then bake into catalog onboarding flow
